hazards.name: Noise (plant, tools, machinery)
hazards.oel_basis: 8 hour rating level, the noise rating limit
hazards.oel_instrument: Noise-Induced Hearing Loss Regulations, 2003, GN R.307, in force to 05/09/2026; from 06/09/2026 the Noise Exposure Regulations, 2024 (GN 5953, GG 52226) retain the 85 dB(A) noise rating limit and add an action level of 82 dB(A) continuous and 135 dB(C) impulse where ototoxic chemical or whole body vibration co exposure exists

hazards.name: Dust, respirable crystalline silica
hazards.oel_instrument: Regulations for Hazardous Chemical Agents, 2021, GN R.280, Annexure exposure limit tables

hazards.name: Hazardous chemicals (agent specific)
hazards.oel_basis: Agent specific limits per the HCA Regulations, 2021 Annexure tables; resolved per named agent at engagement time
hazards.oel_instrument: Regulations for Hazardous Chemical Agents, 2021, GN R.280

hazards.name: Lead and inorganic lead compounds
hazards.oel_basis: 8 hour time weighted average, Lead Regulations occupational exposure limit

hazards.name: Biological agents
hazards.oel_instrument: Hazardous Biological Agents Regulations, staged for a later verification batch

hazards.name: Working at height (above 1.5m)
hazards.oel_instrument: Construction Regulations, 2014, GN R.84, working at height and Annexure 3 fitness certification

hazards.name: Confined spaces
hazards.oel_instrument: General Safety Regulations, staged pending verification

hazards.name: Vibration, hand arm and whole body
hazards.oel_basis: No verified South African occupational exposure limit located for whole body vibration; action values from international guidance are not citable and client measurements are assessed by the OMP
hazards.oel_instrument: Physical Agents Regulations, 2024 staged for verification; Ergonomics Regulations, 2019 for musculoskeletal effect

hazards.name: Heat and thermal stress
hazards.oel_basis: time weighted average WBGT index, regulation 2(4)
hazards.oel_instrument: Environmental Regulations for Workplaces, 1987, GN R.2281; fitness certification for hot work per regulation 5(4)

hazards.name: Driving (licence and PrDP class per notes)
hazards.oel_instrument: National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, PrDP medical fitness provisions; Driven Machinery Regulations, 2015, regulation 18 medical certificate of fitness for lifting machine operators

hazards.name: Shift or night work
hazards.oel_instrument: Basic Conditions of Employment Act 75 of 1997 section 17(3), Code of Good Practice on the Arrangement of Working Time

hazards.name: Ionising or non ionising radiation
hazards.oel_instrument: Hazardous Substances Act 15 of 1973, SAHPRA Radiation Control licensing and dose monitoring framework; dose limits per licence conditions

hazards.name: Electrical hazard
hazards.oel_instrument: Electrical Machinery Regulations, 2011, GN R.250 and Electrical Installation Regulations, 2009, GN R.242; fitness for electrical work per EEA section 7 inherent requirements

hazards.name: Psychosocial hazard
hazards.oel_instrument: COIDA as amended recognises post traumatic stress disorder as an occupational disease from the 2026 commencement

hazards.name: Other (specify in notes)
hazards.oel_instrument: Placeholder key per the canonical questionnaire; never maps to a protocol without OMP direction

hazards.name: Statutory fitness to perform work at a mine
hazards.oel_basis: Not an exposure limit: a statutory fitness determination under MHSA section 13 and the mine's mandatory Code of Practice
hazards.oel_instrument: Mine Health and Safety Act 29 of 1996 section 13; Fitness to Perform Work Guideline, GN R.147

hazards.name: Safety critical railway occupation
hazards.oel_basis: Not an exposure limit: a fitness determination for safety critical railway duty per the RSR human factors framework
hazards.oel_instrument: SANS 3000-4:2011 as a Railway Safety Regulator regulatory tool

instruments.full_citation: Basic Conditions of Employment Act 75 of 1997, section 17(3), read with the Code of Good Practice on the Arrangement of Working Time
Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993, as amended by the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Amendment Act 10 of 2022
Construction Regulations, 2014, GN R.84, Government Gazette 37305, 7 February 2014, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993

Driven Machinery Regulations, 2015, promulgated 24 June 2015 under GNR 539, 540 and 542 of 2015 in Government Gazettes 38904 and 38905, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993. Regulation 18 (lifting machines) requires that lifting machines are operated only by persons who are trained, certified competent, authorised in writing, and in possession of a medical certificate of fitness.
Employment Equity Act 55 of 1998, section 7 (medical testing)

Electrical Machinery Regulations, 2011, GN R.250, Government Gazette 34154, in operation 1 July 2011, read with the Electrical Installation Regulations, 2009, GN R.242, Government Gazette 31975, in operation 1 May 2009, both made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993
Environmental Regulations for Workplaces, 1987, GN R.2281 of 16 October 1987, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993
Ergonomics Regulations, 2019, GN R.1589, Government Gazette 42894, 6 December 2019, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993

Guideline for the Compilation of a Mandatory Code of Practice on the Minimum Standards of Fitness to Perform Work at a Mine, GN R.147, Government Gazette 39656, 5 February 2016, effective 30 June 2016, DMRE reference DMR 16/3/2/3-A3

instruments.short_name: Food Premises Hygiene Regulations, R638 of 2018
instruments.full_citation: Regulations Governing General Hygiene Requirements for Food Premises, the Transport of Food and Related Matters, R638 of 2018, Government Gazette 41730, 22 June 2018, made under the Foodstuffs, Cosmetics and Disinfectants Act 54 of 1972. The Regulations require that no person suffering from a communicable or infectious condition in a transmissible form handles food, and govern the health, hygiene, and protective clothing of food handlers.

General Administrative Regulations, 2003, GNR 929, Government Gazette 25129, 25 June 2003, made under section 43 of the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993 after consultation with the Advisory Council for Occupational Health and Safety, repealing GNR 1449 of 6 September 1996. The Regulations govern incident reporting and recording, health and safety representatives and committees, and administrative duties. They prescribe no standing medical battery: the incident recording duties they impose feed the surveillance programme's review triggers.

General Safety Regulations, 1986, GNR 1031, Government Gazette 10252, 30 May 1986, made under the Machinery and Occupational Safety Act 6 of 1983 and kept in force under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993. The Regulations govern first aid provision, personal protective equipment, work in elevated positions, ladders, and general workplace safety duties. They prescribe no standing medical battery: fitness for the work they govern rests on EEA section 7 inherent requirements.
Hazardous Substances Act 15 of 1973, Group III and Group IV hazardous substances provisions for ionising radiation, administered by the SAHPRA Radiation Control programme
Regulations for Hazardous Biological Agents, 2022, GN R.1887 of 16 March 2022, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993
Regulations for Hazardous Chemical Agents, 2021, GN R.280, Government Gazette 44348 (Regulation Gazette 11263), 29 March 2021, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993
HPCSA General Ethical Guidelines for the Health Care Professions, Booklet 1, December 2021 revision
HPCSA General Ethical Guidelines for Good Practice in Telehealth, Booklet 10, revised December 2021
HPCSA Guidelines on Over Servicing, Perverse Incentives and Related Matters, Booklet 11
Lead Regulations, 2001, GN R.236, Government Gazette 23175, 28 February 2002, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993
Mine Health and Safety Act 29 of 1996, section 13 medical surveillance provisions
Noise-Induced Hearing Loss Regulations, 2003, GN R.307 of 7 March 2003, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993
Noise Exposure Regulations, 2024, GN 5953, Government Gazette 52226, 6 March 2025, made under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993

National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, Chapter 13 professional driving permits, read with the National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000 (GNR 225 of 17 March 2000), regulations 115 to 117: regulation 115 sets the categories of drivers requiring a professional driving permit, and regulation 117(b) disqualifies an applicant who is not medically fit, evidenced by the prescribed medical certificate form completed by a registered health practitioner.
Occupational Diseases in Mines and Works Act 78 of 1973
Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993
SANS 3000-4:2011, Railway Safety Management, Human Factors Management, applied as a Railway Safety Regulator regulatory tool for medical fitness in safety critical railway occupations

roles.title: Site Manager / Supervisor
roles.duties_summary: Site oversight, inspection, coordination of trades
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Regular walking across uneven site terrain; occasional ladder access

roles.title: General Labourer
roles.duties_summary: Manual labour, material handling, demolition and site clearing
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Frequent manual lifting up to 25kg, repetitive bending

roles.title: Scaffolder / Heights Worker
roles.duties_summary: Erecting, altering, and dismantling scaffolding and access structures
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Climbing, working from unprotected edges, carrying loads at height

roles.title: Plant Operator
roles.duties_summary: Operating heavy earthmoving, lifting, and compaction machinery
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Prolonged sitting, foot and hand coordination under vibration
roles.statutory_competency_requirement: Plant operator certificate for the relevant class

roles.title: Welder / Steel Fabricator
roles.duties_summary: Cutting, welding, and fabricating structural steelwork
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Sustained awkward postures, fine motor control
roles.inherent_sensory_cognitive_demands: Colour vision for weld inspection, sustained attention near arc and heat

roles.title: Concrete and Cement Worker
roles.duties_summary: Mixing, placing, and finishing concrete; formwork erection
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Frequent manual handling, kneeling, repetitive strain

roles.title: Electrician (site)
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Working in restricted and confined access, occasional heights
roles.statutory_competency_requirement: Wireman's licence; heights certificate if applicable
roles.inherent_sensory_cognitive_demands: Fine motor control, colour vision for wiring

roles.title: Driver / Plant and Materials Transport
roles.duties_summary: Transporting materials, plant, and equipment between sites
roles.inherent_physical_demands: Prolonged sitting, reversing and manoeuvring in confined yards
roles.statutory_competency_requirement: Valid driving licence; PrDP where required
roles.inherent_sensory_cognitive_demands: Sustained visual attention, reaction time, no uncontrolled hypoglycaemic risk

protocols.test_name: Audiometry
Biological monitoring for specific agents
protocols.biological_reference: [CONFIRM] Agent specific biological reference values are not yet kernel verified and route to the OMP queue; never printed unresolved.

protocols.test_name: Blood lead biological monitoring
protocols.biological_reference: Verified per the Lead Regulations, 2001: medical removal at blood lead 60 micrograms per decilitre (or 10 micrograms ZPP per gram haemoglobin); for women capable of procreation, removal at 40 and return at 30 micrograms per decilitre. Application per individual is the OMP's clinical determination.

protocols.test_name: Chest X-ray per silica protocol
Cholinesterase biological effect monitoring (plasma and erythrocyte) for organophosphate pesticide exposure
protocols.biological_reference: Per the biological exposure indices annexure of the HCA Regulations, 2021, applied from the annexure at examination; interpretation against the individual pre exposure baseline is the OMP's clinical determination.
